verdict.rationale: Jitsu ships an official JS/Segment-compatible SDK (@jitsu/js, confirmed installable via npm in jitsu-probe-rt-2), an HTTP API, and a jitsu-cli for functions/config, which covers 'official SDK' for AI-native integration builders. However, coverage is thin for broader agentic/AI-native SDK usage: no dedicated server-side SDKs beyond HTTP API, no OpenAPI spec (404s in jitsu-probe-2), and community feedback notes higher implementation friction versus competitors like Segment (jitsu-comm-6, jitsu-comm-7). missing for 10: published OpenAPI/REST SDK spec, broader multi-language official SDKs beyond JS/HTTP, independent hands-on validation of SDK ease-of-use matching docs claims.
